facts.fact: The World Bank restructuring paper for the Senegal Digital Economy Acceleration Project says the Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital (MCTN) "introduced" a new digital strategy, the New Deal Technologique, in February 2025, and lists its Axis 1 (universal broadband access), Axis 2 (digitalization of public services) and Axis 3 (transformation of value chains); no adopting act is named.

systems.system: New Deal Technologique (NDT, Digital Transformation Strategy)
systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital (MCTN)
systems.tiers: national; Axis 1 universal broadband, Axis 2 digitalization of public services, Axis 3 transformation of value chains
public administration; cited as the basis of the government enterprise architecture indicator
AI; cited for AI use cases

systems.system: Senegal Digital Economy Acceleration Project (PAENS, P172524)
systems.owner: MCTN and Ministry of Health and Public Hygiene, World Bank IDA financing
systems.tiers: approved 9 February 2023, effective 30 October 2023, closing 31 May 2028; US$150m, restructured to align with the NDT

note: The paper says the project was prepared before the new strategy was developed and is being realigned to its pillars; no text link, period, cost or report for the strategy itself.
